features.title: Deterministic sim core: board, seeded RNG, spawn bag
features.description: Engine-independent simulation of the 5x6 board, pebbles, spawn bag and tick loop, reproducible from a seed and an input stream.
acceptance: Same seed and inputs produce an identical state hash after 10,000 ticks
Spawn bag yields each of 5 families exactly once per 5 spawns
Sim has no engine node or scene dependencies

gate_notes.playthrough: No player-facing flow; the sim is exercised end to end by F002 and F003 playthroughs.
gate_notes.visual: Pure logic module with nothing rendered.
gate_notes.perf: Headless benchmark: 10,000 ticks at max board load within budget on the low-tier device.

features.title: Spawn and merge golems
features.description: Tap Spawn to wake a tier-1 golem; drag onto an identical golem to merge into the next tier.
acceptance: Spawn disabled when the board is full or pebbles are short
Merging two identical golems yields one golem of tier + 1 on the target cell
Invalid drops return the golem to its cell

features.title: Snail waves on the path
features.description: Ten waves of snails crawl around the board; golems auto-attack; leaks cost hearts.
acceptance: Wave 10 spawns the boss, which costs 3 hearts if it leaks
Golems target the snail nearest the gate within range
Snail HP grows 12% per wave

features.title: Hearts, win/lose and results screen
features.description: Track hearts, end the run on win or loss, show coins and stars earned.
acceptance: Run ends at 0 hearts with the loss screen
Win grants 1 star and 40 coins and shows both on the results screen
Results screen buttons sit in the bottom thumb zone

gate_notes.playthrough: Step 14: stars not credited when the last snail dies on the same tick the boss leaks; fix the tie-break order in the sim.

features.title: FTUE: guided first three levels
features.description: Teach spawn, merge and the keep in under 90 seconds with hand-pointer prompts and no text walls.
acceptance: Aha moment (first merge kill) within 45 s for the scripted novice persona
Every FTUE beat stays within its max_seconds
tutorial_begin / tutorial_step / tutorial_complete events fire in order

features.title: Rune Sort bonus levels
features.description: Every 5th level is a sort puzzle that pays runes; levels come from level specs validated by puzzle_solver.py.
acceptance: Loads layout.type sort level specs
Pour rule matches the spec's pour field
Every shipped bonus level is solver-verified within its move limit

features.title: Keep restoration meta (stars to tasks)
features.description: Spend stars on visible restoration tasks; completing an area unlocks a golem family.
acceptance: Area 1 has 5 tasks totalling 12 stars
Completing area 1 unlocks the Moss family and grants 5 gems

features.title: Economy v1 wired to the economy model
features.description: Coins, gems, stars and runes granted and spent exactly as in .gamestudio/economy/v1.economy.json.
acceptance: Every grant and spend goes through one EconomyService and emits earn/spend events
economy_sim.py 30-day run meets the model targets
features.notes: Blocked: the balance pass shows coins hoarding past 5 days of income for engaged_free players; waiting on a sink decision.

features.title: Combat juice and VFX pass
features.description: Merge bursts, snail pops, pebble fly-to-counter, screen shake with the reduced-motion toggle respected.
acceptance: Every player-touched action has visual and audio feedback within 100 ms
Reduced-motion mode disables screen shake and flashes
Within perf budgets at wave 10 with a full board

gate_notes.unit: Presentation-only feature; behaviour is asserted by the playthrough and visual gates.
gate_notes.perf: Peak memory 489 MB > 450 MB budget: uncompressed particle atlases; see perf.json.

features.title: Analytics taxonomy and engine stubs
features.description: Event taxonomy from the contract plus generated GDScript stubs behind one Analytics service.
acceptance: events.taxonomy.json validates
Stubs generated by event_taxonomy.py compile
Debug builds assert required parameters

gate_notes.playthrough: No gameplay change; event firing is covered by unit tests with a fake transport.
gate_notes.perf: Events are batched and sent off the main thread; no measurable frame cost by design.

features.title: Rewarded ad: double coins on results
features.description: Optional rewarded ad on the win results screen doubles coins, capped at 10 per day.
acceptance: Offer is never shown on a loss screen
Daily cap enforced across app restarts
Ad failure grants nothing and shows a calm retry message

features.title: Starter pack IAP
features.description: One-time starter pack offered from level 6, with receipt validation.
acceptance: Offered at most once per day, never during a run
Contents match the contract and the economy model

features.title: Music loop and merge SFX set
features.description: Battle loop with an intensity layer for waves 8-10 plus a 7-step merge clack set rising in pitch by tier.
acceptance: Music loops without an audible seam
Integrated loudness about -16 LUFS with true peak at or below -1 dBTP
All audio assets have approved manifest entries

features.title: Android and iOS exports with CI
features.description: Headless Godot exports for Android (AAB) and iOS (Xcode project) on CI, with every gate run per commit.
acceptance: CI produces a signed internal-test AAB
CI runs static, unit and playthrough gates on every push
